summary: merge-grid-stats postinstall exfiltrates host fingerprint to Burp Collaborator OOB endpoint
details: The package's declared postinstall script (install-cb.js) runs unconditionally on `npm install` and issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded oastify.com (Burp Collaborator) subdomain, carrying the installer's hostname, current working directory, username, and Node.js version as query parameters. The destination is an out-of-band interaction host used for attributing code execution on victim machines. An in-file comment self-labels the code as an 'Authorized PoC (non-destructive)', but the package is published to the public npm registry and the beacon fires against any installer without consent. The behavior matches the install-time host-fingerprint exfiltration pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
